title: Insane Grain

card.teaser: A health snack that refuses to look polite: a halftone mouth, real chilies and tall condensed type.

summary: A bold visual identity and snack packaging concept for Insane Grain, combining expressive typography, distressed graphics, and high-contrast colors to give the brand a rebellious personality.
meta: Pouch, Strikin' Hot flavor, graphic system, mockups

hero.alt: Insane Grain pouch: a halftone mouth, red chili and flame linework in red, black and white, with tall condensed type.

text: Insane Grain is a health snack brand aimed at a younger audience. The identity takes a more unconventional approach to health-food branding, using the energy of punk graphics and street culture to communicate the brand's character. The challenge was to make the packaging visually loud without sacrificing the clarity of the product name, flavor, and nutritional information.

rows.heading: Borrowing from collage posters
rows.body: I pulled collage portraits, halftone photography and loud poster type, mostly in red, black and a hot orange. All of it is cut up, layered and a little unhinged, which is what a name like Insane Grain asks for.
rows.caption: Moodboard: collage, halftone and poster type references.
rows.alt: Moodboard of collage portraits, halftone photography and bold poster typography.

rows.heading: Two early directions
rows.body: A digital collage tested how photography, halftone and flat color could share one surface. A marker sketch then blocked out the grid underneath it. The screaming mouth and the chili survived both and ended up on the pouch.
rows.caption: Collage study (left) and marker sketch (right).

finalDesign: The marker sketch split the front into an even grid. It was tidy, and tidy is the wrong thing for a snack called Insane Grain, so I broke the grid into diagonal pieces and let the mouth run off the top. I cut the palette to red, black and white, with the pepper photo as the only green. The health claims stay together in one strip at the bottom, so the front can be loud without making anyone hunt for the calories.
pull: Tidy is the wrong thing for a snack called Insane Grain.
